name: Grape juice
description: Pressed grapes, usually the dark sweet kind — unfermented, unlike its famous relative.

tcm.note: Read with grapes, which are neutral and fluid-generating.

ayurveda.note: Draksha is shita and one of the classical sweet fruits.

unani.note: Thanda-tar; angoor is cooling in the Unani record.

histamine.note: Grapes carry more amines than most fruit, which is why wine is so bad — juice is far lower, but not zero.
